Name: Muadhnait Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]asarigolo left permissions open for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5053?tab=description]Custom NPC - Muadhnait[/url] so I thought I'd give her a little 1.6 revival![/size]

[size=4]Muadhnait is a mysterious child who never seems to leave the beach and has an almost...otherworldly aura to her. What's going on with this strange girl?[/size]

[size=4]Muadhnait is pretty barebones at the moment. I'd like to flesh her out more as an ongoing project so stay tuned and enjoy![/size]
